requirements.text: Development uses existing accounts/suitable free allowances. Any added paid plan or recurring service has an expected monthly cost proposal and explicit user approval before commitment; list usage assumptions and material limits rather than claim all development is guaranteed free.

behavior_rules.rule: Exact purpose-specific registered diagnostic/owned disposable mutation. Actual environment/checkout/identity/config proof trusted context, sentinel alone insufficient; no production identities/credentials, unrelated worktree, spending/provider effect/board mutation absent actual authorization.

Verified immutable-principal operator capability for the exact positively identified environment/target and registered operation. Not a plant/org role, ordinary job grant, model hint or submitted manifest; no unapproved spend/provider/configuration.

requirements.text: Before real customer data prove coherent database and matching private-byte restore under current access/deletion/external-effect barriers. Selected seven-day history/daily snapshots/object recovery/separate private Tigris encrypted daily bucket and measured ordinary 1hRPO/4hRTO are current targets, not a fresh destination/period questionnaire or guaranteed SLA. Actual cost approval/config/restore proof remains required.

The authenticated same-app Next/Postgres executor uses unique durable jobs, finite leases with a five-minute default, claim generations, heartbeat at most every 30 seconds and checkpoint comparisons. Assessment work uses the 120-second lease and 45-second provider-call bound in the assessment contract. Invocation duration, page size and concurrency must fit the measured deployment. Preserve owed scan tail work, idempotency, at most three backoffs for known retryable failures and handler-specific unknown-outcome reconciliation. Operator recovery rechecks current scope and records its reason and evidence. Per-tenant fairness, reserved slots and alert tuning close at G-LOAD after representative load measurements; they do not block building the base executor. No per-feature queue or separate workflow platform.

Development uses suitable existing free allowances; before paid plans/services/spend obtain explicit approval of concrete measured low/expected/high monthly envelope, recovery/model retry costs, operator load and limits. Before real customer data actual config/key-exclusion/retention/expiry/coherent DB+byte restore and external-effect reconciliation proof must pass. Documentation/prices/selected destination do not authorize setup/restore or certify recovery.

behavior_rules.rule: Read-only DB-clock observed content-free bounded lag by registered job family; no tenant/body/calendar private-care metadata.
Scoped actual existing registered job/manual recovery only; recheck current fence/expiry and domain retry rules, unknown external reconcile cannot become new-key resend or generic arbitrary executor.
Supported expectedState values: ready, claimed, retry_wait, reconcile, succeeded, failed, cancelled, superseded.
Persisted canonical job_state; pending→ready, completed→succeeded, blocked_unknown→reconcile are UI projections only.
Bounded same-app/Postgres tick with finite lease/fence/checkpoint; scheduler fairness tuning belongs to G-LOAD
